```
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                    THE FASHION SYSTEM                            |
|                                                                  |
|  TIERS BY PRICE AND EXCLUSIVITY                                  |
|  --------------------------------                                |
|  Haute Couture          Made to measure; $15,000-$150,000+       |
|  Luxury Ready-to-Wear   Designer RTW; $500-$5,000                |
|  Contemporary           Better RTW; $100-$500                    |
|  Fast Fashion           Mass market; $5-$100                     |
|  Ultra-Fast Fashion     Disposable; $3-$30 (SHEIN)               |
|                                                                  |
|  INDUSTRY STRUCTURE                                              |
|  Design -> Manufacturing -> Distribution -> Retail               |
|  (each step has its own geography and labor economics)           |
|                                                                  |
|  FASHION CALENDAR (traditional)                                  |
|  Feb/March: Spring/Summer shows                                  |
|  Sept/Oct:  Fall/Winter shows                                    |
|  Four main weeks: New York, London, Milan, Paris                 |
|                                                                  |
|  CRISIS DIMENSIONS (2026)                                        |
|  Environmental: textiles = 10% of global carbon emissions        |
|  Labor: global garment worker exploitation                       |
|  Overconsumption: 100B garments made annually                    |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
```
